subject: ggplot2- geom="bar" and facet_grid, problems with space="free"

messages.author: 1dd93a1605f7fe44
messages.subject: ggplot2- geom="bar" and facet_grid, problems with space="free"
parts:
Hi everybody,

I have been using for a while the facet_grid  function using the space="free" option for graphs like boxplots and jitter plots. It is wonderful!

Now I am applying the face_grid function to barplots with the space=free option and the space="free" option does now work.
so the graph gets really clustered because there are many species with no data which I would like to eliminate with the Space="free" option from the barplots.

Anybody knows the reason? is it me? or the geom="bar" does not work with facet_grid and space="free"?

I tried many things and nothing seems to work.


This is my example for the geom="bar" plot.


  qplot(species_name, data = data4, geom="bar",fill=factor(Sex) +  coord_flip()  + facet_wrap(~Tribe,scales = "free", space = "free")

Any help appreciated!!
Thanks,
Maria

messages.subject: Re: ggplot2- geom="bar" and facet_grid, problems with space="free"

Hi Maria,

It's hard to tell without a concrete example, but it's probably the
interaction between coord_flip and facet_wrap - currently only
Cartesian coordinate systems are supported when scales != "fixed"

Hadley
